brief: @buildthis.bisks.net Tell me more about the Czech play that coined the term "robot". What was the precedent leading up to that? Maybe illustrate with a chart
note: built an explainer on R.U.R., the 1921 Czech play that coined "robot" from robota (old word for a serf's forced labor) — with a timeline of the golems, automata, and factories that led up to it.
